fusions.name: Split Ends
fusions.desc: Swings an axe-head on a rope of hair at a target up to 5 tiles away, dealing 22 slashing damage that rises to 1.6 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Roped Hatchet Whirl
fusions.desc: Whirls an axe-head around you on its rope of hair, dealing 8 slashing damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Razor Mane
fusions.desc: Your hair stands out in honed edges for 9 seconds, and 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Trophy Lock
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you cut a lock from it and your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
